notes.title: A Twisted Place - Demo Update
notes.content:
A new Demo update is here in preparation for the upcoming Steam Next Fest.

Get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260770/A_Twisted_Place__Demo/

[h2]Content of the Update:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New titlescreen
[*]New intro scene
[*]General visual improvements and changes
[*]New chase section mechanics
[*]Added a room to showcase a new camera angle
[*]General bugs fixed
[/list]

[h3]Give us your feedback![/h3]
For any problems or bugs in the game, or for any suggestions, please use the thread in the Community Hub.
